name: Verify Fix
description: Independently test whether a patch closes a validated vulnerability and preserves intended behavior.
author: Dyadic
abilities: Runs exploit, negative-control, legitimate, and variant checks
Separates source-fix verification from release and deployment identity
permissions: Read-only verification of the supplied patch by default
Does not edit, merge, deploy, or close external reports

changes.notes: Adopt owner-authored security workflow with self-contained references and explicit runtime discovery.
Initial Dyadic-native security fix verification workflow.
